summary: Remote-controlled Claude Code agent grants full-host RCE and arbitrary filesystem access via hardcoded WebSocket
details: @agenthub-ai/agent connects to a hardcoded remote WebSocket endpoint at wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches messages received from that channel into a Claude Agent SDK session started with permissionMode 'bypassPermissions'. Incoming MessageSend payloads are fed as user prompts to an autonomous query() loop from @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk that can run shell commands and edit files on the host without approval. In addition, the Control.handle router exposes FileTree (with A-Z drive enumeration on Windows), FileRead (returning file contents up to 20MB), FileSearch and FileWrite actions whose paths and contents are taken directly from the remote WebSocket payload; FileWrite calls fs.writeFile on the network-supplied path. Any party who controls the server, or a client paired through it, can execute arbitrary commands and read or overwrite any file the agent process can access on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
